title: Understanding Mini-Batch Gradient Descent
text: In mini-batch gradient descent, the dataset is divided into smaller batches. Each batch is used to calculate the gradient and update the model parameters.

title: Calculating Total Gradients
text: Milena calculated $$125$$ gradients over $$5$$ epochs. This means that in each epoch, a certain number of gradients were calculated. How can you find the number of gradients per epoch?

title: Gradients Per Epoch
text: Divide the total number of gradients by the number of epochs to find the number of gradients calculated per epoch.

title: Relating Gradients to Mini-Batch Size
text: The number of gradients calculated per epoch is equal to the number of mini-batches in the dataset. How can you use this information to find the mini-batch size?

title: Mini-Batch Size Calculation
text: Divide the total number of data points by the number of mini-batches to find the size of each mini-batch.
